The checkboxes and sticky action bar feel natural, and “Select all shown” should mean exactly the bookmarks matching the current search, tag filters, and view. That scope is important.

Keeping the selection after adding or removing tags is useful for doing another action. When an action makes items leave the current view—archive, unarchive, delete, or marking items as read while viewing To read—the affected selection should clear.

One action is still missing: alongside “Mark read later,” I need a bulk “Mark as read” action that removes selected items from To read. With that added, this block matches what I intended.
